activities.summary: New Managing Investments licence activity completed 2025-05-13 for the Saudi arm of Dubai-HQ'd Arqaam Capital. Real trigger, but qualification risk flagged: the parent group likely already runs some group-wide investment/portfolio infrastructure, so 'new licence' may not mean 'no incumbent system' here the way it would for a true de novo entrant. Only a generic company contact (info@arqaamcapital.com) found, no named person.

description: Saudi arm of Arqaam Capital, a full-service investment bank and financial services group founded 2004, headquartered in Dubai with offices across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt and Lebanon. Arqaam Capital Financial (KSA) is CMA-authorised for Advising, Arranging and Managing Investments, covering fund and discretionary portfolio management (DPM) for clients. Completed CMA commencement-of-business requirements for the Managing Investments activity under a resolution dated 2025-05-13. Riyadh office: Olaya Business Centre, Olaya Street.

fit.reasoning: Fit: priority segment asset manager (20) + priority market KSA (15) + multi-asset via fund and discretionary portfolio management (10) + manages third-party client capital, not proprietary (10) + CMA-regulated (5) = 60/60. Timing: a Managing Investments licence activity completed 2025-05-13 — a regional investment bank standing up onshore Saudi fund/portfolio management capability for the first time is a genuine new-mandate-type trigger (15/25), though moderated because the parent group (Arqaam Capital, Dubai) likely already runs some form of investment/portfolio system group-wide that the Saudi entity may inherit rather than buy fresh — worth qualifying directly. Access: no named contact found for the Riyadh office in this pass, only a general company phone/email (info@arqaamcapital.com) (3/15, generic contact only). Total 78 by table, moderated to 63 given the real risk that this entity runs on a group-wide platform already, which is the kind of 'already mid-implementation, no dissatisfaction signal' pattern the ICP flags to qualify carefully rather than assume displacement is easy.

name: Arqaam Capital Financial Company (Saudi Arabia)
